name: SBNA Chat Widget for CCXAI
author: SBNA Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd

sections.description:
The SBNA Chat Widget for CCXAI lets you easily add a secure live chat feature to your website, powered by CCXAI. Simply enter your company name and unique identifier to enable validated customer conversations.

Integrated Service

This plugin communicates with a first-party system (CCXAI) to deliver chat functionality. It does not use any third-party external service.

CCXAI Customer Chat System
– Purpose: Loads a live chat interface within an iframe for direct customer interaction.
– Data Sent: Company name, identifier code, and a unique UUID (LoginUserId) are passed in the iframe URL. Users may also provide their name (required), and optionally their email and phone number.
– Data Received: Chat interface UI and messaging data required for live communication.
– When: Triggered when users submit the chat form or when an existing session is restored via sessionStorage.
– User Consent: Before starting a chat, users must check a consent box agreeing to share their data. A link to the privacy policy is provided.
– Terms of Service: https://ccxai.com/terms-and-conditions/
– Privacy Policy: https://ccxai.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sbna-chat-widget-for-ccxai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SBNA Chat to configure your company name and identifier code.
sections.faq:
How do I get a Company Name and Identifier Code?

Sign up for a CCXAI account at https://ccxai.com/ and retrieve your credentials from the dashboard.

  • Improved: Escape key support to close the widget.
